summary: East kerb of Rankin Street backing onto bush, with cars parked and homes across the road.
reasons: Backs onto bushland, no homes this side
Other cars park along this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Bush reserve on the kerb side; nearest homes are 18-20 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge and cars already parked along this kerb; room for a van.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb; 2P signs apply weekdays 9am-5pm only.

flags: Steep: about 11% grade, 16.6% max over the full stretch
Crossfall unknown on a sloping street
sun_shade: Bush shades the kerb from the east and afternoon sun; open to the north.

best_section.where: East kerb of Rankin Street along the bush reserve, past the first bend north of the corner
